metadata.case_name: LEUNG YUN KEUNG v. CITYBASE PROPERTY MANAGEMENT LTD

plaintiff.occupation_before: In the building materials business for about 40 years; director and a 20% shareholder of a medium-size building materials company; General Manager

injuries.description: As recorded in Caritas’ medical report, Mr. Leung’s right eye had proptosis (outward bulging), chemosis (swelling of the conjunctiva), deformed globe and vitreous haemorrhage. Posterior rupture of eyeball was suspected.
source: As recorded in Caritas’ medical report, Mr. Leung’s right eye had proptosis (outward bulging), chemosis (swelling of the conjunctiva), deformed globe and vitreous haemorrhage. Posterior rupture of eyeball was suspected.
injuries.icd_description: Ocular laceration or rupture with prolapse or loss of intraocular tissue, unilateral

injuries.description: The experts – as noted in their report (“the Joint Report”) – found that Mr. Leung’s right eye was effectively blind due to the presence of the optic nerve atrophy, poor retinal circulation and a large fibrous strand on the retina.
source: The experts – as noted in their report (“the Joint Report”) – found that Mr. Leung’s right eye was effectively blind due to the presence of the optic nerve atrophy, poor retinal circulation and a large fibrous strand on the retina.
injuries.icd_description: Other specified injury of eye or orbit

injuries.description: The blindness is irreversible due to the presence of the optic nerve atrophy, poor retinal circulation and large fibrous strand on the retina[3].
source: The blindness is irreversible due to the presence of the optic nerve atrophy, poor retinal circulation and large fibrous strand on the retina[3].
injuries.icd_description: Other specified traumatic injuries of the retina

injuries.description: In Dr. Jon’s report, it is recorded that after the first operation the retina was attached. “However, anterior and posterior vitreoretinopathy with tractional detachment gradually developed with dense epiretinal membrane and fold over right macula was noted.”
source: In Dr. Jon’s report, it is recorded that after the first operation the retina was attached. “However, anterior and posterior vitreoretinopathy with tractional detachment gradually developed with dense epiretinal membrane and fold over right macula was noted.”
injuries.icd_description: Other specified traumatic injuries of the retina

injuries.description: The procedure of the second operation involved posterior vitrectomey, membrane removal and silicone oil exchange.
source: The procedure of the second operation involved posterior vitrectomey, membrane removal and silicone oil exchange.
injuries.icd_description: Other specified traumatic injuries of the retina

manifestations.description: Reduction in about 25% of the visual field
Impairment of judgment of distance and depth judgment

treatments_received: Second operation on 29 September 2006 (posterior vitrectomey, membrane removal and silicone oil exchange)
treatments_future: Possible operation for removal or exchange of silicone oil (if complications such as elevated intraocular pressure or pacification of the silicone oil occur)

losses.description: Right eye effectively blind causing loss of stereopsis, about 25% reduction in visual field, impairment of distance and depth judgment and mild impairment of visual acuity.
